note: Selection input only. Repository + record reference per source key. No title, date, creator, or URL is authored here -- those are captured from the repository by tools/capture-era1.py and recorded in era1-raw-captures.json.
periodBound: Michigan Grade 7 W1 -- Era 1, beginnings to 4000 BCE

si-nmnhanthro.name: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History -- Department of Anthropology
si-nmnhanthro.metadataRightsPosture: Record metadata is released CC0 by the Smithsonian; the metadata_usage.access value is captured per record as returned.
si-nmnhanthro.publicUrlSource: The record's own descriptiveNonRepeating.record_link (an ARK at n2t.net). No public URL is constructed here.

discoveryQueries.note: Queries run against the repository's own search API at discovery time. Only the queries listed under each source's discoveredBy produced a registered record; the others returned nothing this lane could use inside Era 1. Negative results are not captured -- re-run them to reproduce the search rather than trusting this list.

si-nmnhanthro-8177446.contradiction: The repository's culture value for this record is Protoneolithic, but the record's own title and object type say iron. Iron working postdates Era 1 by millennia, so the label cannot be an age for this object. Registered only as evidence about how catalogue labels work; it is not Era 1 evidence and does not count toward the anchor minimum.

si-nmnhanthro-8177447.contradiction: The repository's culture value for this record is Protoneolithic, but the record's own title and object type say coin. Coinage postdates Era 1 by millennia, so the label cannot be an age for this object. Registered only as evidence about how catalogue labels work; it is not Era 1 evidence and does not count toward the anchor minimum.

era1CultureMapping.statement: The repository assigns a culture to a record. It does not say whether that culture falls inside Era 1 (beginnings to 4000 BCE). Reading these culture names as Era 1 is a judgement this lane makes, and it is the second premise behind every in-period claim in era1-verified-sources.json. It is declared here so it can be argued with. tools/build-era1-sources.py reads this list; the set is not hardcoded in the tool.
era1CultureMapping.caveat: A culture name inside Era 1 is not a date for an individual object. See each record's periodClaim.basis, and the two counter-examples.
